title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
blurb: Tensors, autograd, nn.Module, convnets and a full medical-imaging project (classification, segmentation, fine-tuning), then modern practice: AdamW, schedules, mixed precision, torch.compile, debugging and export. Runnable NumPy versions of every building block and 30 implementation problems.
sources: Stevens, Antiga & Viehmann, Deep Learning with PyTorch (Manning), ch. 1–15
PyTorch documentation (docs.pytorch.org): torch.amp, torch.compile, torch.export, torch.onnx, torch.utils.data
Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville, Deep Learning — background for optimisation and regularisation
